status: Selected facts checked against pinned third-party SR28 mirror and its included original format documentation; official provider directly unverified
dateNote: September2015 is a source release, not the observation date of every nutrient or a current 2026 analysis. November10 is retrieval/adoption availability.

sourceDocumentation.per100g: sr28_doc.pdf printed p7: mean values per100g edible portion
sourceDocumentation.totalSugar: sr28_doc.pdf printed p13: sum of mono/disaccharides; not added/free sugars
sourceDocumentation.rawCooked: sr28_doc.pdf printed p11: cooking changes mass and retention; do not interchange raw/cooked weight

reuseStatus.scope: Only selected factual rows/derived arithmetic. No third-party application code copied and no full database should be committed.

explicitNonMappings.reason: No verified same-food Korean source. USDA zucchini 11477 is a different cultivar/species selection; do not silently map.
USDA miso16112 is not verified equivalent to Korean doenjang; do not silently map.

measurementWarnings: Count, bowl and spoon quantities need an explicit selected weight; no universal hidden conversion.
Egg large edible weight50g is an available USDA WEIGHT row, not every egg.
Oil tsp4.5g and soy sauce tsp5.3g are available selected-food USDA rows.
Existing app onion200g, yogurt tbsp15g and rice210g are app assumptions, not this database measurements.
Salt/pepper 조금 has unknown grams; do not assign arbitrary dash weight.
Do not include new reference estimates in historical actual meal records without provenance and availability checks.
scope: Only the fourteen food facts selected by the runtime. No full source database or third-party application code copied.
priceReferenceRelationship: Separate from the martmemo price reference: nutrition SR28 release2015 and price survey2026-10-23 are different sources and dates.

nutrientUnits.water: g in source only; runtime stored water mL is not inferred
nutrientUnits.sugar: g total sugars, not free or added sugars
